bestSingle.validityGuard: proposed: retain current source on candidate hard failure when current is valid; raw and guarded results reported separately

preferredSelector.validityGuard: proposed: retain current authored source only when candidate hard-invalid and current valid; guard never chooses by post-layout soft quality

jointChoiceRule: best three distinct-engine global configurations, ranked by hard-valid coverage, acceptable coverage, finite regret; default and selected presets share reference oracle
sourceIntentRule: Nested structural recipes, authored pins and required hints are preserved. Explicit change-direction edits override the predicted/default direction with the requested direction before compilation.
acceptanceGate: contract: at least95% relative feasible-pool common coverage separately per profile, no new current-valid hard failure, specialist losses need explicit escape. Conservative absolute95% is separate sensitivity

minimumConfigurationPolicy.nativeRecipeAvailability: All six structural recipes, implicit baseline, and authored current source whose engine dependencies are retained; this is separate from the counted global configurations.
minimumConfigurationPolicy.objective: Smallest configuration count meeting relative95% separately under all common profiles with no new current-valid hard case; ties maximize accepted jobs then valid jobs. Engine set was chosen first; this is not joint exhaustive optimization over every engine/configuration set.
